eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Texas; at 4:30 PM on AUG 20, 2025 Effective until 4:30 PM AUG 21, 2025. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: AMBER Alert: Child Abduction from Salado, Texas. Missing child is Natalie Driver, 13 year old white female last seen wearing a black shirt, black shorts, and wears glasses. Suspect is Kyle Price, 18 year old white male. Call Bell County Sheriff's Office with information. If seen call 9 1 1.
